:::{#sol-kfold}

1. $32 / 4 = 8$ cars per fold.
2. Each fit leaves out one fold,
   so it uses $32 - 8 = 24$ cars.
3. One model per fold, so $4$ models.
4. A given car is in exactly one fold.
   It is used for prediction once,
   when its fold is left out,
   and for fitting in the other $3$ fits.

:::
